edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the later commentary printed with it is not included.
edition.zh: 据维基文库；不收附印的后人评注。

basis.en: Northern Song prose; the author died in 1073.
basis.zh: 北宋散文，作者卒于 1073 年。

note.en: Zhou Dunyi’s short essay of 1063 on the lotus, which rises from the mud unstained. In a hundred and nineteen characters it sets three flowers against three ways of living. Notice the last turn: he asks who shares his love of the lotus, and does not answer.
note.zh: 周敦颐 1063 年的短文，写出淤泥而不染的莲。一百一十九个字，以三种花对照三种活法。留意最后一转：他问谁与他同爱莲，却不作答。

excerpt.orig: 予獨愛蓮之出淤泥而不染，濯清漣而不妖
excerpt.en: I alone love the lotus: it rises out of the mud and is not stained by it; it is washed by clear ripples and is not showy.
excerpt.zh: 予独爱莲之出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖

gloss.en: Tao Yuanming (365–427), whose best-known line is ‘Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern hedge, at ease I see the southern hills.’
gloss.zh: 陶渊明（365—427）有名句“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”。

gloss.en: The Tang dynasty, whose ruling house was named Li.
gloss.zh: 唐朝皇帝姓李，故称李唐。

gloss.en: In Tang Chang’an the peony was a craze; Bai Juyi wrote that one clump of dark blossoms cost as much as ten households paid in tax.
gloss.zh: 唐代长安盛行赏牡丹。白居易《买花》说：“一丛深色花，十户中人赋。”

gloss.en: 濯 is to wash, 漣 the ripples of clear water.
gloss.zh: 濯，洗；涟，水的波纹，指清水。

gloss.en: The lotus stem is hollow inside and straight outside.
gloss.zh: 莲茎中间是空的，外形是直的。

gloss.en: 蔓 and 枝 are used as verbs: it puts out no runners and no branches.
gloss.zh: 蔓、枝，都用作动词。不生藤蔓，不长枝节。

gloss.en: 益 means the more: the further the scent travels, the purer it grows.
gloss.zh: 益，更加。香气越远越清幽。

gloss.en: 亭亭 is tall and upright; 植 means to stand.
A recluse who has withdrawn from office and the world.
The Confucian gentleman: a person of cultivated virtue rather than of rank.
gloss.zh: 儒家所说品德高尚的人。
